This role serves as the primary technical lead for network services, ensuring reliable, secure, and scalable connectivity while partnering with Corporate Infrastructure and Security teams, business stakeholders, and external service providers to support operational and strategic business objectives Core Responsibilities Network Infrastructure Management Design, implement, maintain, and support network infrastructure to ensure high levels of availability, performance, reliability, and security. Manage network technologies including routing, switching, wireless networking, telecommunications, and network segmentation. Monitor network performance, capacity, and availability, proactively identifying opportunities for optimization and service improvement. Maintain network documentation, standards, technical procedures, and operational records. Service Operations & Support Manage network-related incidents, service requests, and escalations in accordance with established service levels and operational procedures. Lead problem management activities, including root cause analysis and implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Serve as the technical escalation point for complex network issues and operational challenges. Change & Project Management Plan, assess, coordinate, and implement network infrastructure changes through established change management processes while minimizing business risk and service disruption. Lead network infrastructure projects, technology refresh initiatives, site expansions, and operational improvement programs. Coordinate project execution with business stakeholders, corporate teams, vendors, and service providers. Vendor, Security & Compliance Management Manage relationships with telecommunications providers, contractors, technology vendors, and support partners to ensure effective service delivery. Collaborate with Corporate Infrastructure and Security teams to implement enterprise standards, security controls, and network-related initiatives. Support audit, cybersecurity, compliance, risk management, and business continuity requirements. Technical Leadership Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge sharing to team members. Promote operational excellence, standardization, and continuous improvement initiatives. Contribute to infrastructure strategy, technology evaluation, and future capacity planning. Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum 7 years of experience in Network Engineering, Infrastructure Operations, or a related technical field. Experience supporting enterprise network infrastructure within a manufacturing environment and collaborating with regional or global IT organizations. Proven experience in incident management, change management, project delivery, and vendor management. Technical Expertise Strong knowledge of enterprise networking technologies, including routing, switching, wireless networking, telecommunications, network monitoring, and security principles. Experience designing, implementing, and supporting highly available, resilient, and scalable network infrastructure. Familiarity with manufacturing and operational technology (OT) environments is highly desirable. Preferred Certifications CCNP, Aruba, Juniper, Fortinet, ITIL, or equivalent industry-recognized certifications.

review_candidates.description: Requirements Description & Requirements who we are lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people. About This Team The Identity Governance team at lululemon sits within Cybersecurity and is responsible for governing digital identities and access across our global enterprise. We ensure the right accounts have the right access to the right systems, applications, and data for the minimum time required, balancing strong security controls with a great user experience. The team designs, builds, and operates identity lifecycle management, access governance, and identity and access risk services, that support workforce, third party, and non human identities at scale. Through automation, policy enforcement, and continuous improvement, we reduce risk, support regulatory compliance, and enable secure business growth. Our work is foundational to protecting guest and employee data while enabling innovation across lululemon’s technology ecosystem. Core Responsibilities As a Cybersecurity Engineer, you will own security engineering for specific systems and platforms, designing and implementing security controls that balance protection, performance, and usability. You will build, test, and maintain security solutions including automation, libraries, and tooling, apply secure coding practices, and support security testing and validation. You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to integrate security into system design and delivery, drive improvements to security control effectiveness, and mentor junior engineers while contributing to high-quality, scalable security implementations. Select Responsibilities Include Build comprehensive security systems implementing authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, secure identity services, and security enforcement Develop security code and tools creating security platforms and libraries, scanners and detectors, security frameworks and policies, and security automation tools Implement security at scale building security controls that work across multiple systems Conduct security code reviews reviewing code for security vulnerabilities and implementation issues Test security thoroughly performing security testing, penetration testing, and code security analysis Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field; security certification preferred 4-8 years of experience designing and implementing security solutions, building security platforms and automations, or embedding security into systems, or equivalent Proven experience implementing comprehensive security controls across systems including multi-layered defence mechanisms; demonstrated ability to build advanced authentication systems including multi-factor authentication and identity management solutions Experience writing security-critical code including security libraries and middleware; track record of leading security code reviews, establishing secure coding standards, and identifying architectural security issues Proven ability to conduct comprehensive penetration testing and security code analysis; experience building comprehensive security tools including scanners, testing frameworks, and validation systems 4-8 years demonstrated engineering experience with Identity Access Management and Identity Governance platforms such as SailPoint IIQ / Identity Service Cloud (ISC) and Entra ID Proficient in Beanshell, Java, SQL, JDBC, REST API, Web Services, and utilizing AI (Github Copilot, etc.) to improve - for example - application code, deployment methodologies, testing, role mining, operational support must haves Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. The Company reserves the right to alter these incentive programs, benefits, and perks in whole or in part at any time without advance notice. workplace arrangement Hybrid In-person collaboration and connection is important to our culture. Identity & Security: Du setzt IAM/RBAC, Managed Identities/Service Principals und federated identities (OIDC/Workload Identity) sauber um IaC, GitOps & CI/CD für Infrastruktur: Du definierst Infrastruktur reproduzierbar mit Terraform/Tofu nutzt GitOps- und Pipeline-Workflows (z. B. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI) Observability: Du etablierst Monitoring, Logging, Tracing und Alerting (z. B. Azure Monitor/CloudWatch + zentrale Logs/Diagnostics) und erhöhst Verfügbarkeit & Performance. Cloud-native Infrastruktur: Du setzt Container-Orchestrierung (Kubernetes), Serverless-Patterns und Managed-Services sinnvoll ein – inkl. Standardisierter Deployments . Anforderungen Cloud-Know-how: Erfahrung mit Azure (Konsole/Portal sicher bedienen); erste Praxis im Bereitstellen & Managen von Ressourcen in der Cloud. Compute & Netzwerk: Vertraut mit den verschiedenen Compute Möglichkeiten und dem sicheren setup von privaten Netzwerken IaC & Automation: Praxis mit Terraform/Tofu (gern Terragrunt), CLI-Automatisierung (Azure CLI/AWS CLI); Git-Workflows sind dir vertraut. Secretless & Security Basics: Verständnis für IAM, RBAC, Managed Identities/Service Principals, OIDC/Workload Identity, Netzwerk-Security, Verschlüsselung und Compliance-Grundsätze. Observability: Du kennst mindestens eine Monitoring-Lösung (z. B. Azure Monitor/CloudWatch) sowie Logging/Diagnostics für Infrastruktur. Scripting & OS: Mindestens eine Skriptsprache (Python, PowerShell oder Bash) und Linux-Basics (Login, Navigation, Dateien, CLI-Tools). Cloud-native Patterns: Du weißt, wie Kubernetes/Container-Orchestrierung und Serverless in Infrastruktur-Designs sinnvoll eingesetzt werden. Arbeitsweise & Kommunikation: Teamgeist, positive „Can-do“-Haltung, saubere Doku, Problemlösung mit Blick fürs Detail; Deutsch & Englisch (mind. C1). #Jobster

review_candidates.title: Associate Cloud Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good. We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey. Role Overview We seek a motivated Cloud Security Engineer at a junior to mid-level to help implement and manage robust security controls for our cloud-based platforms. The ideal candidate will have a growing background in cybersecurity engineering coupled with cloud practices, and a strong appetite to learn. As a Cloud Security Engineer, you will play an important role in safeguarding our business cloud environments against potential threats and vulnerabilities. Working alongside senior engineers and the broader technology team, you will help identify vulnerabilities, develop solutions, and deploy effective controls to ensure our data and systems' confidentiality, integrity, and availability. This is a hands-on growth role that requires solid technical foundations and a genuine interest in information security best practices. Location This position will be based in either our Frankfurt (Germany) or London (United Kingdom) office. The candidate is required to attend the office a minimum of 3 days per week but may voluntarily elect to work either remotely or from the office for the remaining days of the week. Key Responsibilities Support the design and implementation of security controls for cloud-based platforms, helping ensure compliance with industry standards and regulations such as ISO 27001, FedRAMP, NIST, IRAP, and SOC 2. Assist with technical risk assessments of cloud infrastructure and applications, helping identify potential security gaps and recommending countermeasures. Assist with the development and maintenance of cyber security technical controls and operations, standards, and procedures for cloud deployments in collaboration with cross-functional teams. Support technical third-party security audits and assessments. Help identify and assess vulnerabilities, risks, and cyber security threats and their impact on Nuix's platforms and applications. Help implement and configure security controls across various cloud services, such as AWS and Azure. Participate in incident response activities under guidance, including supporting investigations of security breaches and helping implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Monitor and analyse security logs, alerts, and events to help identify and respond to security incidents and threats. Collaborate with development and operations teams to help integrate security into the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and DevOps processes. Help manage and maintain security infrastructure, including vulnerability scan tools, intrusion detection and prevention systems, anti-malware solutions, and other security platforms. Skills, Knowledge And Expertise Tertiary qualification in Computer Science or related field, or relevant experience. Up to 3 years of experience in cybersecurity or IT roles, with some exposure to cloud security (including internships, graduate programs or relevant project work). Some experience working as an IT Security Engineer or in a similar role, with a focus on information security, is desirable. Foundational knowledge of network and system security principles, practices, protocols, and technologies. Hands-on exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS, O365 and Azure. Working knowledge of security technologies and protocols, such as Vulnerability tools, Data protection, encryption, IAM, endpoint detection, and event/incident management. Familiarity with industry security standards and frameworks, such as ISO 27001, NIST, and CSA. Good analytical and problem-solving skills, with a willingness to tackle complex security issues and develop effective solutions. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders. Entry-level or associate certifications (e.g., AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, Azure Fundamentals AZ-900, CompTIA Security+, or working towards AWS Certified Security – Specialty / CCSP) preferred. Experience with scripting and automation tools for security tasks (e.g., Python, PowerShell) is a plus. Awareness of EMEA regulatory and data-protection requirements (e.g., GDPR) is a plus. About NUIX Nuix is on an incredible journey of transformation, aligning our strengths with our ambitions to pursue greater opportunities. As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values. https://www.nuix.com/ As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values. Nuix Vision Finding Truth in a Digital World. Nuix Mission Statement Nuix creates innovative software that empowers organizations to simply and quickly find the truth from any data in a digital world. We are a passionate and talented team, delighting our customers with software that transforms data into actionable intelligence. Nuix Values TAKE OWNERSHIP RESILIENT UNAFRAID TEAM NUIX HERO OUR CUSTOMERS

review_candidates.title: Cloud Security Engineer
review_candidates.description: In the Technology division, we leverage innovation to build the connections and capabilities that power our Firm, enabling our clients and colleagues to redefine markets and shape the future of our communities. This is a Lead Cyber Security Engineering position at Director level, which is part of the job family responsible for providing specialist cyber expertise and creating solutions that protect the organization's systems and networks against actual and potential security threats and vulnerabilities. Morgan Stanley is an industry leader in financial services, known for mobilizing capital to help governments, corporations, institutions, and individuals around the world achieve their financial goals. Interested in joining a team that’s eager to create, innovate and make an impact on the world? Read on. The Cloud Security Engineer plays a critical role in the design, engineering, implementation, and operational support of the firm's multi-cloud infrastructure strategy across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This position is responsible for establishing and maintaining the foundational cloud services, security controls, networking architecture, identity solutions, automation frameworks, and platform integrations that enable secure, scalable, and resilient cloud adoption across the enterprise. As the organization continues to expand its cloud footprint and integrate acquired businesses, this role is essential to ensuring consistent governance, operational excellence, and security across diverse cloud environments. The Cloud Security Engineer serves as a key technical leader responsible for reducing risk, accelerating cloud adoption, enabling developer productivity, and supporting critical business initiatives through standardized cloud platforms and automation. What You’ll Do In The Role Design, implement, and manage foundational cloud services across AWS, Azure, and GCP, including landing zones, organizational structures, identity and access management, networking, security services, and shared platform capabilities. Develop and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures aligned with enterprise standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices. Build and automate cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) technologies such as Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM/Bicep, and associated CI/CD pipelines. Partner with Security, Networking, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Platform Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to deliver secure-by-design cloud solutions. Establish and maintain cloud governance, guardrails, monitoring, logging, and compliance controls across all supported cloud service providers. Drive cloud modernization, standardization, and integration initiatives across new business acquisitions and legacy environments to ensure alignment with enterprise cloud operating models. Support developer enablement through the creation of reusable platform services, automation capabilities, reference architectures, and self-service cloud solutions. Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex cloud infrastructure, networking, security, and operational issues across multi-cloud environments. Evaluate emerging cloud technologies and recommend strategic improvements that enhance security, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency. Collaborate with risk, audit, compliance, and regulatory teams to support assessments, control validation, remediation activities, and evidence collection. Contribute to cloud strategy, architecture reviews, technical standards, and long-term platform roadmaps. What You’ll Bring To The Role Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, related discipline or equivalent experience. 5+ years of experience designing and supporting enterprise-scale cloud infrastructure and services. Deep expertise in AWS, Azure, and/or GCP, with the ability to operate across multiple cloud providers. Strong experience with cloud networking, identity, security architecture, and governance models. Proven experience with Infrastructure-as-Code and automation technologies including Terraform and CI/CD pipelines. Experience supporting highly regulated environments and working with audit, compliance, and security control frameworks. Strong understanding of cloud security principles, DevSecOps practices, monitoring, observability, and operational resiliency. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and non-technical audiences. Demonstrated ability to lead complex cloud transformation, migration, and integration efforts. What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work. review_candidates.title: Network Operations Center Engineer
review_candidates.description: Technical Operations Staff (NOC/Helpdesk) PT Putra Garsel Interkoneksi membuka kesempatan bagi kandidat yang memiliki minat dan kemampuan di bidang IT, jaringan, dan operasional layanan untuk bergabung sebagai Technical Operations Staff . Posisi ini berperan dalam mendukung operasional layanan dan jaringan perusahaan, mulai dari monitoring, koordinasi pekerjaan, penanganan kendala teknis, pengelolaan data layanan, hingga memastikan setiap pekerjaan operasional berjalan dengan baik. Dalam pelaksanaannya, penempatan dan pembagian fungsi akan disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan perusahaan serta kompetensi kandidat , yang dapat mencakup fungsi NOC/Helpdesk, Dispatch, Aktivasi & Billing, maupun Troubleshoot . Tanggung Jawab Melakukan monitoring terhadap kondisi jaringan dan layanan pelanggan. Menerima, mencatat, dan menindaklanjuti laporan atau kendala layanan. Melakukan troubleshooting awal terhadap permasalahan jaringan. Membantu menganalisis gangguan seperti koneksi putus, koneksi lambat, latency, packet loss, dan kendala jaringan lainnya. Melakukan koordinasi dengan teknisi lapangan dan tim internal dalam penyelesaian pekerjaan. Melakukan monitoring dan follow-up terhadap pekerjaan atau tiket yang sedang berjalan. Membantu proses aktivasi dan perubahan layanan pelanggan. Melakukan input, pengecekan, dan pengelolaan data pada sistem perusahaan. Memastikan setiap pekerjaan dan penanganan kendala terdokumentasi dengan baik. Membuat laporan pekerjaan dan hasil monitoring secara berkala. Menjalankan tugas operasional lainnya sesuai kebutuhan dan arahan perusahaan. Kualifikasi Pendidikan minimal SMK/D3/S1 , diutamakan jurusan: Teknik Komputer & Jaringan, Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, Teknik Elektro, atau bidang terkait. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1 tahun di bidang NOC, Helpdesk, IT Support, Network, atau bidang yang relevan . Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar dengan kemampuan dasar jaringan yang baik. Memahami dasar jaringan komputer, khususnya: TCP/IP, Routing & Switching, Troubleshooting jaringan, MikroTik/Cisco menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki pemahaman mengenai MikroTik . Terbiasa melakukan monitoring jaringan menggunakan tools monitoring menjadi nilai tambah. Memahami dasar sistem operasi Windows ; Linux menjadi nilai tambah. Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik. Mampu menangani permasalahan dengan cepat dan sistematis. Teliti, responsif, bertanggung jawab, dan mampu bekerja di bawah tekanan. Memiliki kemampuan dokumentasi dan reporting yang baik. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift apabila dibutuhkan. Bersedia melakukan pekerjaan on the road/lapangan apabila diperlukan. Sertifikasi MTCNA, CCNA, Ruijie, Juniper , atau sertifikasi jaringan lainnya menjadi nilai tambah. Penempatan Penempatan akan disesuaikan dengan kebutuhan operasional perusahaan dan hasil assessment kandidat , yang dapat meliputi: NOC/Helpdesk | Dispatch | Aktivasi & Billing | Troubleshoot
